payload.blocks: Every land that touches the main checkout: the discussion land of ds-que32ftgg6 and ds-jxoz3h2qgk (refused foreign-staged-index) and, likely, phase 5 of plan 261125-2313 (q-bvvdct5edg).
payload.headline: Main checkout lags HEAD after land da11e3533; restore the 12 landed files from HEAD so lands resume?

parts.cause: Land operation land-774156-1795667922689953145-1 (writer pid 774110, now dead) moved the ref but never synced the checkout. The supervisor ran `fgos git recover` (allowed): it kept the operation with ref-authority-mismatch and changed nothing, so the recommendation of q-bvvdct5edg does not fix it. The supervisor has no grant for main-checkout-reset, and lead:SUPERVISOR cannot be reached by message.

options.does: Owner (or lead:SUPERVISOR) runs in /home/vantt/projects/forgent: `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- CHANGELOG.md apps/fgos/src/wiring/git_incidents.rs apps/fgos/tests/git_recover_confirm_dead.rs docs/platform/git/spec.md packages/git/contracts/mutation-census.v1.json packages/git/rust/src/incidents.rs packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-manifest.json packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-routes.json plans/261017-1313-fgos-platform-program-board/log.md plans/backlog/p-xz3rns7o52-backlog-to-ready-pipeline-as-a-domain-agnostic-workflow.md src/cli/command-registry.mjs test/git/commit-parent-death.test.mjs`, then `git status --short` shows none of them.
options.gain: The checkout matches HEAD; the foreign-staged-index refusals stop; lands resume.
options.harm: None found: for those 12 paths the files equal the index (no unstaged edits), so only the stale pre-land copy is replaced. The other dirty files (.claude/settings.json, .fgos/config.yaml, .fgos/distribution.json, ds-jxoz3h2qgk DISCUSSION.md) are left untouched.
options.label: Restore the 12 paths from HEAD

options.cost: One command plus redoing those edits.
options.does: Resets the whole checkout to HEAD under the checkout mutex.
options.gain: Same sync through the official door.
options.harm: Discards the four unrelated uncommitted edits of other sessions.
options.label: main-checkout-reset --sha da11e3533 --confirm

options.harm: Lands from the main checkout stay refused.
options.label: Leave it

parts.recommendation: Restore the 12 paths from HEAD: it fixes exactly the stale paths and keeps other sessions' work.

scope.allows: Restoring those 12 paths from HEAD in the main checkout; heads then retry their lands; q-bvvdct5edg may then be cancelled by its asker.
scope.forbids: Resetting or cleaning any other path, deleting refs, worktrees or locks.

parts.what: HEAD is da11e3533 (land git-recover-confirm-dead, 11:27), but the main checkout's index and files still hold the tree from before that land and before 38bc0f359: 12 paths are staged 'M'/'D' that exactly undo those two commits (the 10 files of the land, the program-board log.md and backlog row p-xz3rns7o52). The full list is in the first option's command.
